description: Get a Deepstate order-book snapshot for a market — bids descending, asks ascending, with each price level’s resting size. Reflects the last completed on-chain state read rather than every intervening block; the returned block number names exactly which height it was read at. Call 1s_ds_markets for the list of available book slugs.

book.description: Deepstate market identifier: the 32-byte book_id, or its canonical uppercase slug (e.g. "NVDA-USDG", "DEEP-USDG"). Call 1s_ds_markets first for the full list of available markets and their slugs.

depth.description: Maximum price levels returned per side (1-500, default 50)

name: 1s_ds_book
title: Deepstate Order Book
